quarter.zh: 2026 财年第四季（6 月季度）

en: Revenue rose 48% to $3.63B, beating the ~$3.49B consensus, with a record 52.7% non-GAAP gross margin and $5.71 of adjusted EPS against ~$5.10 expected. Fiscal 2026 revenue was $12.2B with $3.1B of free cash flow. CEO Dave Mosley said HAMR drives reached about 40% of nearline exabytes and capacity is booked into 2027, and the company guided the September quarter to $4.1B with operating margins near 50%. CFO Gianluca Romano expects margins and cash generation to keep rising through fiscal 2027.

The stock had slid about 18% in the four days before the report, so the beat brought only a 2.3% gain the next day, followed by an 11% jump the day after as analysts raised targets. It went on to $973 in mid-August, then fell back as investors worried about new supply: a report that Toshiba would double its AI drive capacity and news of a bidding contest for TDK's heads business cut about 18% in early October.
zh: 营收增长 48% 至 36.3 亿美元，高于约 34.9 亿的预期；非 GAAP 毛利率创纪录达 52.7%，调整后每股收益 5.71 美元，预期约 5.10。2026 财年营收 122 亿美元，自由现金流 31 亿。CEO 戴夫·莫斯利表示 HAMR 硬盘已占近线出货约 40%，产能已预订至 2027 年；公司指引9月季度营收 41 亿美元，营业利润率接近 50%。CFO 吉安卢卡·罗马诺预计 2027 财年利润率与现金创造将持续上升。
财报前四个交易日股价已下滑约 18%，因此超预期业绩次日仅涨 2.3%，再隔一日随分析师上调目标价大涨 11%。8月中旬一度升至 973 美元，随后因担忧新增供给回落：东芝将把 AI 硬盘产能翻倍的报道，以及竞购 TDK 磁头业务的消息，令股价在10月初下跌约 18%。

bio.en: Joined Seagate in 2004 and ran operations, technology and sales before becoming CEO in 2017; now also chairman. He holds a PhD and has led the long bet on HAMR recording, which is now driving record margins.
bio.zh: 2004 年加入希捷，历任运营、技术与销售负责人，2017 年出任 CEO，现兼任董事长。拥有博士学位，主导了对 HAMR 记录技术的长期押注，如今正推动利润率创纪录。

bio.en: CFO since January 2019. Before Seagate he held a series of senior finance roles in the semiconductor industry. Under him Seagate has cut debt and kept capex light while returning cash through dividends and buybacks.
bio.zh: 2019 年1月起任 CFO。加入希捷前，在半导体行业历任多个高级财务职位。任内希捷削减债务、保持轻资本开支，并以股息与回购回馈股东。
